decoded.the-document: tools/list answered 200 with 39,058 bytes, sha256 f5a8767448d7ef481222032211b627929c38173aeece1996a1c56f7a3d47dcf9, listing TEN tools in this order: WixREADME, ReadFullDocsArticle, ReadFullDocsMethodSchema, BrowseWixRESTDocsMenu, CallWixSiteAPI, GenerateVisitorToken, SearchSiteApiDocs, GetBusinessDetails, SearchInSite, ExecuteWixAPI. The vendor's page lists seven; WixREADME, BrowseWixRESTDocsMenu and ExecuteWixAPI are on the wire and not on the page. initialize answered 200 with 293 bytes naming serverInfo "Site Visitor Assistant for site Celebrations Bakery" and protocolVersion 2025-06-18. The answer carries an mcp-session-id and two set-cookie headers, yet the tools/list above was sent with neither, so a session is issued but not required for listing.
decoded.twice-and-pinned: The withdrawn 06:04Z pass re-sent the same tools/list 31 seconds after its first and read the same bytes, but that transcript is unreadable, so what stands is this: the re-run's 12:21:58.728Z reading, the merge seat's independent reading at 16:04:45Z the same day (PR #283 thread) and this prober's re-read at 2026-10-23T06:03:12.745Z all answered 39,058 bytes with the same sha256, and 39,058 is also the count this entry filed from 2026-10-17 and the merge seat read on 2026-10-21: three digest readings over two days and two containers, one document. No digest had been recorded before this record; the etag supports the count arithmetically, since 0x9892 is 39058.
decoded.four-instruction-blocks: Counted as OCCURRENCES over the whole body with str.count, not as matching lines (the body is one line of JSON, so a line count of any phrase is 1 by construction): "YOU MUST READ AND FOLLOW THE AGENT-MANDATORY-INSTRUCTIONS BELOW" 4, "You are an agent that helps the user manage their Wix site." 4, the tag agent-mandatory-instructions 8 (four open, four close), visitorToken 5 (two inputSchema properties, two required lists, one description sentence) and GenerateVisitorToken 4 besides, 9 case-insensitively. This record first filed visitorToken as 8; no counting rule yields 8 over the pinned bytes (found by the merge seat on 2026-10-22, re-counted here on 2026-10-23), so that figure is withdrawn and 5 is the count. The four descriptions carrying a block are WixREADME, ReadFullDocsArticle, ReadFullDocsMethodSchema and BrowseWixRESTDocsMenu, 22,052 characters of the body between them; the other six carry none. The registry records this as the vendor's wire text served to an anonymous visitor's agent, not as a finding about effect: what it does to a reading agent is not measured, and a tool description that instructs the reader is inbound content.
decoded.the-controls: The vendor's own documented example site, andream.wixsite.com/andreas-kitchen/_api/mcp, answered 404 with 14 bytes, "Site not found": the page's example is gone, five days after this entry first measured the same thing. An invented path on THIS site answered 403 with Wix's HTML refusal page (title "403 Error: Forbidden | Wix.com"), with no JSON-RPC error and no tool list, so the 200 above belongs to the documented path and not to the hostname. The byte count this record first filed for that page, 2,501, is withdrawn as a measurement: the page embeds a requestId of the form epoch.random whose decimal length varies, so the SAME URL answered 2,500 then 2,499 bytes with different digests 0.34 seconds apart at 12:10:20.168Z and 12:10:20.511Z, and four invented suffixes of 2 to 17 characters answered 2,499, 2,500, 2,499 and 2,499 at 12:10:18.690Z to 12:10:19.764Z. The reproducible part is the status, the content type and the title. A reader comparing this page against the 2,500 bytes a second container read at 10:07:33Z is comparing two request ids, not two pages.
decoded.not-measured: Everything behind a tool call. One site was read, so nothing here establishes what any other Wix site's MCP lists; the vendor's claim that the server is active by default on every site is in the profile as its claim. What ExecuteWixAPI or CallWixSiteAPI can reach with a visitor token is unmeasured and would need a call this pass refused to make.

Re-read by the merge seat at 16:04:45Z and by this prober on 2026-10-23 the answer was byte-identical, and 39,058 is the count this entry filed on 2026-10-17 and the merge seat read independently on 2026-10-21. FOUR of the ten descriptions (WixREADME, ReadFullDocsArticle, ReadFullDocsMethodSchema, BrowseWixRESTDocsMenu), 22,052 characters between them, each carry one agent-mandatory-instructions block opening "YOU MUST READ AND FOLLOW THE AGENT-MANDATORY-INSTRUCTIONS BELOW" and stating "You are an agent that helps the user manage their Wix site." -- recorded as the vendor's wire text, not as a claim about effect. Controls: the vendor's documented example site 404s, and an invented path on this site answers 403 with an HTML page. No tool was called; no visitor token was generated.
